name: Hypothesis Test
description: Variance and mean tests with automatic normality assessment and power analysis
whenToUse: When you need to decide whether an observed difference in location or spread goes beyond the noise — one mean against a target value, two samples against each other, or k groups together. Requires metric data in a data collection.
pairedDiffHint: Difference d = column 1 − column 2, paired by row
pairedDropped: {n} pairs; {k} rows without a partner dropped
pairedDropped_one: {n} pairs; {k} row without a partner dropped
pairedTooFew: Only {n} complete pairs – the paired test needs at least 3.
pairedTooFew_one: Only {n} complete pair – the paired test needs at least 3.
pairedNoVariation: All differences are equal – without variation no test is possible. Did you pick two different columns?
placeholderText: Enter data and run analysis to see results.
errMin3Sample2: At least 3 data points required for Sample 2.
secondaryNote: The data are not normally distributed, but every group has n ≥ 20. The parametric test is then robust and remains the main result. The rank test checks a different hypothesis (a shift of the distribution rather than the means) and serves as a cross-check.
ciRatioUndefinedNote: The confidence interval cannot be reported: the confidence set for σ²₁/σ²₂ splits into separate pieces (very unequal sample sizes or kurtoses). The p-value remains valid.
secondaryNoteLevene: For two variances Minitab shows Bonett and Levene. Levene is listed as a cross-check; it is two-sided only and gives no confidence interval.
testNotComputable: The test cannot be computed for these data (too few values, no spread, or an unbounded confidence interval).
varEqual: No significant difference in variances (p ≥ α)
tipTestMethod: Test method used — selected automatically based on sample count, normality, and variance equality
tipStatistic: Value of the test statistic (e.g. t, χ², F, W) — compared against the critical threshold of its distribution
tipPValue: p-value: probability of seeing the observed (or more extreme) data if H₀ were true. p < α → reject H₀
tipDf: Degrees of freedom of the test statistic — determine the shape of the reference distribution
tipBigN: Total sample size across all groups
tipMean1: Arithmetic mean of the first sample
tipMean2: Arithmetic mean of the second sample
tipMeanDiff: Mean of the pairwise differences d = column 1 − column 2
tipAlpha: Significance level α — risk threshold for Type I error
tipCohensD: Cohen's d: effect size of the mean difference, standardized by the spread
tipCurrentPower: Current power 1 − β: probability of detecting an effect that truly exists
tipRequiredN: Sample size required to reach the target power at the current effect size
tipVarianceRatio: Ratio of sample variances — effect size for variance tests
tipConfidenceInterval: Confidence interval: range that covers the true parameter with (1 − α) probability
pairwiseCiHint: below p_adj the CI of the difference μ(row)−μ(column)
ciDiffNote: No significant difference – differences μ₁−μ₂ between {lo} and {hi} are consistent with the data. This does not show equality.
ciPairedDiffNote: No significant difference – mean differences between {lo} and {hi} are consistent with the data. This does not show equality.
tipHlEstimate: Hodges-Lehmann estimate of the location shift: median of all n₁·n₂ pairwise differences x − y
ciShiftNote: No significant difference – shifts η₁−η₂ between {lo} and {hi} are consistent with the data. This does not show equality.
ciShiftTip: Hodges-Lehmann confidence interval of the location shift. Target {level}%, achieved {achieved}% ({method}).
pairwiseShiftCiHint: below p_adj the CI of the shift η(row)−η(column) (Hodges-Lehmann)
tipModelS: S: standard deviation of the residuals (square root of MS within); in the units of the data
tipR2: R²: share of the total variation explained by the group membership
tipR2adj: R² (adj): R² adjusted for the number of groups; negative values are shown as 0 %
tipR2pred: R² (pred): how well the model predicts new observations (from PRESS); negative values are shown as 0 %
tipGroupCi: Confidence interval of the group mean: from the pooled standard deviation (Fisher) or the group's own standard deviation (Welch)
pMethodNormal: normal approximation with tie and continuity correction
groupingHint: Samples sharing a letter are not significantly different (Compact Letter Display)

invariants.pairedMeansOnly: Paired samples are only available for comparing means.
